items.orchestrator_proposed_disposition: PROPOSED: RATIFY S2's routing. FIXUP-2 = one claude-sonnet-5 execution per part (routed: p01, p02, p03, p06, p07, p08, p11, plus any part a class ruling below adds), attempt ids ezek_author_fixup2_pNN_a1, first execution #e1. Each orders file carries its S2 findings verbatim (claim, evidence, suggested_fix) and the class items ruled here, each stamped with its S2 or CWO id. #e4 FIXUP-1 (3) and (4) bind unchanged (replace only; no span, unit_type, confidence or parent change), with #e6 T5-REGISTER (a)-(c) and T5-MARKS (1) in the brief. Orders sit in SP/Ezek/fixup2/ and land through _land_author_part_ezek.py in FIXUP mode with no change. The apply runs _apply_author_wave_ezek.py --fixup after a guarded change that takes the receipts path from an argument, with a selftest vector showing the fixup1 default unchanged. Output is repair/rows_v5_fixup2.jsonl; then whole-book tiling, the suite HARD GREEN, and coverage for CWO-EZ-01..09, 14..18 and every predicate ordered here. S3 reads S2-01's rows back first.

S1-15 named the key family but no p05 row; FIXUP-1's p05 orders carried only S1-09.", "suggested_fix": "Rule a corpus-wide deterministic or author sweep for oss keys that encode a parashah mark (closure.parashah_*, closure.pe, closure.samekh), proven by one coverage report (E-18); this covers S2-03's rows too."}

Section 8: parashah keys barred from oss, disclosure in prose only.", "suggested_fix": "Drop closure.pe; keep the pe disclosed in prose and refs; add a closure key only where a formula device stands in the closing verse. Spans unchanged."}

Strategy section 8, verbatim (whitespace normalized): 'Parashah marks are disclosed in prose ("pe follows MT 24:27, single witness") and never as an oss key; intra-verse parashah position is never asserted.' / 'parashah.* keys BARRED from oss (disclosure in prose only);'.
#e4 S1-ROUTING (1), verbatim: "(1) RE-ROUTES: S1-15's author part adds p08 (P08-007's oss key closure.pe encodes a mark) beside p06 (closure.parashah_* keys), p09 and p01 (the stray resh);".

S2 FQ-07 disposition verbatim: {"id": "FQ-07", "disposition": "neither", "evidence": "Section 8 bars mark-encoding oss keys and binds a closure key only where its device stands in the closing verse. Neither 27:36 nor 28:19 carries an inventoried formula; both prose fields disclose the mark (SAMEKH after 27:36, PE after 28:19 in pmarks) and the terminal clause. A 'closure.mark_only' key would re-encode the mark in oss, which is exactly what S1-15 removed, so the untagged close is correct. Optional for the controlling agent: the terror refrain shared by 26:21, 27:36 and 28:19 (skeleton sweep: 3 verses) could earn a content closure key."}.

Orchestrator measurement over rows_v4_fixup1, every observed_substrate_signals string, regex closure\.(?:parashah_\w+|pe|samekh)\b: 7 keys on 7 rows in parts p05, p08: [{"row": "P05-004", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[3]", "key": "closure.parashah_samekh"}, {"row": "P05-005", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[3]", "key": "closure.parashah_samekh"}, {"row": "P05-006", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[2]", "key": "closure.parashah_pe"}, {"row": "P05-008", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[4]", "key": "closure.parashah_samekh"}, {"row": "P08-002", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[3]", "key": "closure.pe"}, {"row": "P08-003", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[2]", "key": "closure.pe"}, {"row": "P08-007", "field": "observed_substrate_signals[8]", "key": "closure.pe"}].
items.orchestrator_proposed_disposition: PROPOSED (A): rule the class barred under section 8, since a closure key that names a mark is the mark encoded in oss. CWO-EZ-19 is a predicate sweep over every row's observed_substrate_signals for closure\.(?:parashah_\w+|pe|samekh)\b, run as its own sweep with its own coverage report (E-18); today it finds 7 keys on 7 rows. The remedy is one author item per hit in FIXUP-2: drop the key; confirm the mark is disclosed in prose, adding the disclosure where it is absent; add a content closure key only where a formula device stands in the closing verse (FQ-07). That adds p05 to FIXUP-2. After the apply the coverage report must read residual 0. (B): the orchestrator drops the keys deterministically and orders author items only where the prose lacks the disclosure. That is cheaper, but the disclosure judgment then sits with the orchestrator, not an author.

items.orchestrator_proposed_disposition: PROPOSED: rule the class inside section 8's curly-quote rule, since a one-word span is still a curly double quote. CWO-EZ-20 is its own predicate sweep and coverage report (E-18) over every string field: a curly double-quoted span of one word with no web: ref in its field. The remedy is an author item per hit in FIXUP-2, because the right fix differs by case: a gloss becomes single-quoted, and a WEB word keeps its curly quotes and gains its web: ref. That adds p09 to FIXUP-2. The tool arm (check_web_quotes line 206's one-word skip) is S2-15's question. ALTERNATIVE: a deterministic conversion to single quotes on the CWO-EZ-18 precedent. That is cheaper, but it mishandles any span that is WEB-verbatim.

items.question: Rule the S2-13 class: campaign-convention talk and error-ledger ids (E-NN) in row prose. Does section 8's bar cover them?
facts: S2 finding verbatim: {"id": "S2-13", "severity": "minor", "route": "controlling_agent", "row_or_artifact": "row prose corpus-wide (at least P01-003, P01-006, P01-014, P03-001, P03-003, P03-007, P03-014, P03-020, P04-001, P04-002, P04-004, P04-007, P04-008, P07-006, P08-002, P08-010, P09-002)", "claim": "Campaign-convention talk and error-ledger ids stand in row prose; no ruling says whether section 8's governance/decision-id bar covers them.", "evidence": "'a hard seam that the campaign rule holds no unit may cross' (P01-006); 'the trigger the campaign uses' (P04-002); 'the addressee-change condition this campaign requires' (P09-002); '(E-23)' on P01-003 x3, P01-014 x3, P04-004, P04-008; 'the E-02 cap' on P03-001, P03-020, P07-006, P08-010. 11 rows with campaign talk, 8 with E-NN ids; all present in v3.", "suggested_fix": "Rule the class; if barred, order a sweep with its own coverage report and add the arm for Daniel's toolkit."}

Strategy section 8, verbatim (whitespace normalized): 'Row prose (all 22 fields) never contains: decision-ids, strategy-file/§ citations, erratum or repair narration, positional row references (incl.
